The site is Starlight Ridge Dark Sky Observatory — Public Viewing Pass, a event-registration web application for Dark sky observatory public viewing night sign-up.

Owner brief: "Our rural dark-sky observatory holds weekly public telescope viewing sessions with strict capacity limits. We need a registration page where stargazers select a date, enter the number of adult and child attendees, and reserve their telescope passes. Reservations must be saved on the server so reloading the confirmation ticket page retains the attendee count and gate pass code."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-07/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Starlight Ridge Dark Sky Observatory — Public Viewing Pass: the page for dark sky observatory public viewing night sign-up, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #030712 (ds-bg), #0b1120 (ds-surface), #111c33 (ds-card), #1e2e4f (ds-border), #38bdf8 (ds-cyan), #6366f1 (ds-indigo), #f1f5f9 (ds-text), #94a3b8 (ds-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 12px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ds-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a capacity or deadline the page mentions but never enforces; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Starlight Ridge Dark Sky Observatory — Public Viewing Pass as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Visitor and attendee names", "Contact email", "Contact phone", "Viewing night date", "Observation session", "Party size (total attendees)", "Adult tickets", "Child tickets", "Accessibility and telescope requirements").

User journey context: View upcoming observatory viewing night dates and remaining ticket capacity. Select an open night, fill in visitor names, party headcount, and submit registration. View the gate pass ticket with registration reference and reload the browser to verify persistence.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
